brand_mark_suggestion: A minimalist, solid geometric monogram 'LP' constructed from overlapping transparent layers or a crisp, custom-kerned logotype in Cabinet Grotesk using a slashed 'O' (LicenzPøl) to evoke technical precision and code. Never use software box metaphors.

rules: No generic sans-serif for headings (no Inter, Roboto, Arial).
Headings must have tight letter spacing.
Labels must be uppercase with extreme tracking.
Body text should contrast well but remain slightly muted (zinc-400) to let data and products shine.

colors.archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Luxury Tech
rules: NO purple gradients on white. Avoid full-screen gradients.
Backgrounds must be deep black or near-black.
Use category colors purely as subtle accents (e.g., a 2px glowing line, a small dot, or a tag background at 10% opacity) rather than large blocks of color.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use the 'Crystal Glass' approach for floating elements like navigation and cart drawers: backdrop-blur-2xl with bg-black/60 and a delicate border-white/10.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate subtle grain/noise overlays over hero banners and dark sections to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere for structural grid lines. Use border-white/5 or border-zinc-800.

components_guidance.nav: Sticky glassmorphism header (z-50) with logo on left, clear navigation links center, cart/language/search on right. Active states use a subtle white underline. NO transparent headers over content.
components_guidance.hero: A massive, immersive dark section. Large Cabinet Grotesk typography. The background should feature a subtle, slow-moving abstract 3D element or a dark grain texture. CTA must be highly visible, pill-shaped.
components_guidance.product_card: Abstract representation. Do not use software boxes. Instead, use a deep dark card with a geometric composition or a large typographic 'mark' representing the software, plus category color accents. Include explicit data points: Price, OS icon, License duration.
components_guidance.category_tile: Bento-style layout. Large squares or tall rectangles featuring subtle gradient meshes mapping to the category tone (e.g., soft blue for Work, pink for Design).
components_guidance.variant_selector: Interactive chips, not native <select> dropdowns. When selecting a variant (e.g., '1 PC', '5 PCs'), the chip outlines with a glowing 1px border. Fluid layout, clearly indicating the active selection.
components_guidance.comparison_table: Strict Swiss-style grid. Horizontal borders only (border-b border-zinc-800). No vertical borders. Checked attributes use a crisp white icon. High contrast text for advantages.
components_guidance.cart_drawer: Slide-out from right. Glassmorphic background. Clear cost breakdown. Sticky checkout button at the bottom.
components_guidance.checkout_stepper: Linear flow. Minimalist. Step 1: Cart, Step 2: Info (Guest only), Step 3: Payment (Demo state), Step 4: Success. Use a horizontal progress bar or numbered pills. The Payment step must have a clear 'Demo Mode' transparent UI overlay or explicit notice.
components_guidance.faq_accordion: Minimalist borders. Question in Outfit font. Plus/Minus icons that rotate on open. Border bottom only.
components_guidance.footer: Massive bottom padding. Grid layout for links. Include a giant logotype 'LicenzPol' (text-[10vw]) at the very bottom.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous. Use p-8, p-12, p-24. Containers must have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.general: Follow the 'Bento' grid protocol for discovery sections (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12). Leave negative space. Asymmetrical layouts for editorial feel.
grids_and_layouts.product_page: Split layout. Left: Sticky abstract visual (sticky top-24). Right: Scrolling details, variants, activation steps, and cart actions.

motion.hover: Translate Y slightly (-translate-y-1), border color brightens, subtle ambient shadow appears.
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slide up slightly. Staggered list reveals for product catalog.
motion.micro_interactions: Variant switches trigger a fast snap animation. Add-to-cart changes button state to 'Added' with a checkmark before resetting.
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling (Lenis style recommended for feel, if custom JS is used) and parallax on abstract background assets.

accessibility.contrast: Text must meet APCA standards. Zinc-400 on Black is ~60 Lc (acceptable for body), White on Black is maximum.
accessibility.focus: Use explicit focus rings: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-white focus:outline-none.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute. E.g., data-testid='add-to-cart-button', data-testid='category-filter-work'.

hero_background.description: Abstract 3D glass cubes reflecting neon light. Use as a highly dimmed background for the main hero.

category_work_manage.description: Stacked cubes in cold, structural tones. Use as abstract visual for database, OS, or management software.

category_protect.description: Black and blue abstract rectangles. Use for cybersecurity, antivirus, or infrastructure software categories.

category_design_create.description: Abstract purple and pink gradient waves. Use for creative suites, design tools, and multimedia.

icons.style: Line icons, crisp (1.5px to 2px stroke width), no emojis.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium hybrid full-stack e-commerce experience.
Do not use Shadcn for the main marketing landing page layouts; use raw HTML/Tailwind for bento grids and hero sections.
Use Shadcn UI for interactive elements: dropdowns, modals, tabs, accordion, forms.
Do not build a real checkout. The payment step must show a 'Demo Mode' UI.
Create a realistic software catalog (e.g., Windows 11 Pro, Microsoft Office 2021, Adobe Creative Cloud, Kaspersky Total Security) with plausible prices.
Do NOT use real product box images. Use typographic/geometric CSS styling for product cards, blending category colors and abstract shapes.
Implement IT / EN toggle (default to Italian strings for content).
Do not use generic 'Inter' or 'Roboto'. Inject the specified fonts (Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono) via Google Fonts or standard imports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use bold typography and strict grids.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Create depth with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/40 border-white/10).
Never use `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`.
Never center-align the app container globally.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
No AI emojis in UI. Use lucide-react icons.
Ensure every interactive and key element has a `data-testid` attribute.
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors to prevent inheritance issues.
